intended_raw.instrument: NQ raw geometry / MNQ monetary scaling by caller
intended_raw.session: Default/Globex proxy from observed Grid24 bars
intended_raw.denominator: mean High-Low of preceding 20 observed chart bars, excluding current
intended_raw.momentum: current chart close minus chart close 12 observed bars ago
intended_raw.current_bar_guard: observed index + 1 - assumed MaxBarsBack20 > 20; all pre-start history retained
intended_raw.entry: signal close 08:30..14:30 inclusive, next observed chart-bar open
intended_raw.hold: entry chart bar counts as completed held bar1; queue exit when held count reaches HoldBars
intended_raw.ordinary_flat: queue market exit on chart close>=14:55; next observed chart open, wall14:55 when contiguous
intended_raw.costs: raw geometry only; caller charges two market fill slips and round-trip fee
intended_raw.quantity: one raw NQ unit; account quantities applied externally
intended_raw.source_state: whole observed chart chronology before eligibility filtering; no date reset
intended_raw.coverage: Apex requires finite OHLC08:26..14:56 regular /08:26..11:31 early, plus known timely fills
intended_raw.gap_policy: retain raw known exits; audit missing held spans; never invent an exit or fill an absent bar
intended_raw.closure_caveat: early NQ closing clock is an explicit proxy, not independently verified calendar parity
